title: Atlas acquisition earnout valuation
prompt:
Value the Atlas earnout for investment committee using the current probability-weighted case.

Use the July corporate-development investment-committee correspondence, the 7/5 controller-tied IC book, the current data-room export, the diligence review notes, and the approved underwriting policy. Treat the 6/29 banker case as change history only.

Use the mutually exclusive scenario probabilities and contractual payouts in the current case. Calculate the undiscounted expected payout, then discount it over the full settlement period at the approved earnout rate. Keep the contractual maximum separate from the probability-weighted result, and calculate the probability of any payout by excluding only the zero-payout scenario.

Identify the most value-sensitive operating metric using the documented one-standard-deviation fair-value changes rather than the raw scale of the operating metrics.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `undiscounted_expected_payout`, `earnout_fair_value`, `maximum_payout`, `probability_of_any_payout`, `most_sensitive_metric`. Use dollar amounts to two decimals and probabilities as decimal ratios to at least four decimals.
